professionalSummary: Three years of experience as an Implementation Consultant at an HR software company, configuring payroll and absence products for 23 mid‑size employers under the company’s configuration standard.
Expertise in conducting policy workshops, resolving internal customer disagreements, and documenting decisions with customer sign‑off.
Proficient in loading and reconciling employee data with the data migration team, producing signed reconciliation reports.
Skilled in training HR administrators, managing go‑live approval processes, and recording responsibility boundaries.
Experienced in documenting implementation limitations and hand‑over conditions for support teams.
experienceHighlights: Configured payroll and absence products for 23 mid‑size employers, adhering to the configuration standard.
Led policy workshops using the workshop method, capturing decisions and resolving disagreements with customer sign‑off.
Collaborated with the data migration team to load and reconcile employee data, producing signed reconciliation reports.
Trained HR administrators per the training plan, documented go‑live approval and personal responsibilities.
Authored limitation notes and hand‑over conditions for each implementation, included in the hand‑over pack.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Workshop records with customer sign‑off (2 samples).
Go‑live checklist with manager approval (1 sample).
Hand‑over pack with limitation notes and hand‑over conditions (1 sample).

evidence.text: Implementation consultant at an HR software company for three years, configuring the payroll and absence products for twenty-three mid-sized employers under the configuration standard.

Work sample: two workshop records with the customers' sign-off, one reconciliation report, one go-live checklist with the manager's approval and one hand-over pack, with the implementation tool references as a verification trail.

Ran the policy workshops for each implementation under the workshop method; the workshop records show the policy decisions captured, including the disagreements within customer teams resolved into a recorded decision, with the customers' sign-off on each workshop record.

In the workshop exercise, when the two panel members playing the customer disagreed on the overtime policy, the candidate wrote both positions on the board, asked which payroll rule each would produce, showed the two resulting payslips, and recorded the decision the customer then made with the name of the decider.
Loaded and reconciled each customer's employee data with the data migration team, with the reconciliation report signed by the customer's HR lead.

Work sample: two workshop records with the customers' sign-off, one reconciliation report, one go-live checklist with the manager's approval and one hand-over pack, with the implementation tool references as a verification trail.
Trained the customers' HR administrators under the training plan; go-live approval was the implementation manager's, recorded on the go-live checklist together with which checks were mine.

Work sample: two workshop records with the customers' sign-off, one reconciliation report, one go-live checklist with the manager's approval and one hand-over pack, with the implementation tool references as a verification trail.
Wrote the limitation note and the hand-over conditions for each implementation in the hand-over pack to the support team.
